types.label: Nothing is building
types.description: No build is running while the Queue has work (with the reason: no free account, no Fable account, a split still to come), or the Queue is empty and builds wait in Pending for you. Pushed to the phone once per idle spell; cleared when a build runs.

types.label: Dispatcher self-check
types.description: The dispatcher checked every Claude account one by one (signed in, limited, API key saved and not rejected, free slots) and either fixed something (released a slot held by an ended session, cleared an expired limit, put a build that never ran back in the Queue) or found an account it can't use, with what to do.

types.label: Build started
types.description: The dispatcher started a headless session for a Queue build: which account, which model, which phase.

types.label: Build ended, returned or failed
types.description: A dispatcher session ended: every step done (built), crashed and back in the Queue, stopped early and back in Pending for you, or failed after too many runs.

types.label: Build split into steps
types.description: The orchestrator split a new build into steps (or had to fall back to rules and asks you to review them).
